text:
lucy_sales (Sales): Pinging the team: Aether Labs wants a 3-week POC. They've exported a custom variant named 'orca-nano-12b-q3f' and want to validate on Dedicated (A100). Asks: reserved pricing for ~1.1M tokens/mo, session-persistent KV cache, Private VPC + BYO-KMS, and any runtime blockers for their q3f quant. cc @noah_ml @ravi_ops @mina_sec

noah_ml (Eng-ML): Two quick clarifiers: 1) Does their export include fused ops or custom kernels? 2) What's the p95 latency target and average prompt/response lengths? Fusion affects kernel selection and may require rebuilds.

lucy_sales (Sales): They target p95 <= 320ms. Typical prompts ~35 tokens, responses ~180 tokens. They said export used "light fusion" and a custom quant script (q3f).

noah_ml (Eng-ML): q3f isn't one of our standard quant paths. We'll need either their quantization script + sample checkpoint or an unfused checkpoint. If they can share a sample wheel/checkpoint we can run a quick compatibility test on staging. Potential extra work if the quant math deviates.

ravi_ops (Solutions): Ballpark reserved effective rate for a 12B q-ish variant on A100: ~$0.005 to $0.012 per 1k tokens depending on utilization, batching, and KV hit rate. I'll refine after Noah's perf test and assuming ~30-40 peak concurrency.

mina_sec (Security): BYO-KMS + Private VPC supported. Ask them to provide KMS key ARN, key policy and rotation cadence. Also send our security questionnaire and KMS integration checklist. If they plan to process regulated data (PHI/PCI) flag it now.

noah_ml (Eng-ML): For staging please provide: model artifact (wheel or checkpoint), the q3f quant script or docs, 30-50 validation prompts, and a concurrency trace (burst shape). Example smoke config I would run on Dedicated: 
```yaml
model: orca-nano-12b-q3f
precision: q3f
hardware: a100-80gb
batching:
  max_tokens_per_batch: 6144
  latency_target_ms: 300
kv_cache: session_prefix_persistent
seq_max: 2048
```

noah_ml (Eng-ML): Note: if q3f uses nonstandard normalization (e.g., fused RMSNorm+bias or custom attention), our kernel selector may fallback to slower paths. That usually shows up in the smoke perf run. If they cannot provide artifacts, allow ~3 business days for compatibility work.

lucy_sales (Sales): I'll request checkpoint + quant script + 50 prompts and push them to mark the security questionnaire high priority.

infra-bot: Ticket POC-9901 created: "aether-poc-staging" assigned to eng-ml and eng-infra. ETA: 48h.

ravi_ops (Solutions): Cost sensitivity: KV hit rate matters a lot. If session prefix reuse >=60% we can expect effective per-token reduction ~20-30%. Also burst concurrency affects required pool sizing; please get a 24h trace if possible.

mina_sec (Security): Also request their desired retention window and SIEM forwarding needs. For BYO-KMS we require the key policy before we wire the key to the private control plane.

noah_ml (Eng-ML): Once artifacts are in I'll run perf + quick quality regression vs our baseline and post any kernel/op incompatibilities. If we see fused ops we may ask for the training export command and CUDA/cuDNN versions.

lucy_sales (Sales): Aether said no PHI. I'll post artifacts here when they reply. Thanks everyone — will update once I get uploads. :rocket:
